BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repetitive motion injury notices; and adding anew section to chapter 49.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On January 1st of each year, the department shall publish listsof employers with the best and the worst records of repetitive motioninjuries. (a) The list of employers with the best records shall include: (i)The twelve percent of employers with the lowest numbers of repetitivemotion injuries; (ii) the twelve percent of employers with the lowestrates per employee of repetitive motion injuries; and (iii) the twelvepercent of employers with the lowest repetitive motion injury costs. (b) The list of employers with the worst records shall include:(i) The twelve percent of employers with the highest numbers ofrepetitive motion injuries; (ii) the twelve percent of employers withthe highest rates per employee of repetitive motion injuries; and (iii)the twelve percent of employers with the highest repetitive motioninjury costs. p. 1 HB 3027 (2) Each employer that appears on the list described in subsection(1)(b) of this section shall post and keep posted a current copy of thelist in a form provided by the department. The list shall bepositioned in a readily accessible location and within plain view ineach work site where an employee or employees are employed. Inaddition, the employer shall post specific health and safety standards,if any, recommended by the employer or the department to avoidprospective repetitive motion injuries.
